set.display.drawing.help: How the scan is drawn. Auto does what the scene's link asks (SuperSplat's ?stochastic and ?budget). Stochastic is SuperSplat's new drawing that skips sorting the splats and leaves a fine grain. Sorted is the classic, smooth drawing. Stochastic needs WebGPU in a desktop browser.
drawing.on: Stochastic drawing (SuperSplat beta), {budget} M splats · Settings → Display
drawing.note.scene-handheld: This scene asks for SuperSplat's stochastic drawing. It only runs in desktop browsers, so here the scene is drawn the classic way.
drawing.note.scene-webgl: This scene asks for SuperSplat's stochastic drawing. It needs WebGPU, which this browser does not offer, so the scene is drawn the classic way.
drawing.note.setting-handheld: You chose the stochastic drawing in Settings → Display. It only runs in desktop browsers, so here the scene is drawn the classic way.
drawing.note.setting-webgl: You chose the stochastic drawing in Settings → Display. It needs WebGPU, which this browser does not offer, so the scene is drawn the classic way.
drawing.note.budget-handheld: This scene asks for {budget} M splats, a budget for desktop browsers. On this device it draws at most {top} M.
drawing.note.budget-webgl: This scene asks for {budget} M splats. Without WebGPU it draws at most {top} M.
